headline: McDonald's Japan says a third party got into its app's customer database, reaching purchase history and phone location data.
summary: New incident page. Read McDonald's Japan's own notice (Nov 20, in Japanese, unchanged since) and The Record (Nov 24). Main answer Confirmed and answer_group hack-stated: the company itself says a third party got unauthorized access. incident_type breach. No service: the notice does not say the app or any service stopped. What was not included and 'no misuse found' are the company's word alone, so Reported. Open: how many people, whether data was copied, how the credentials were obtained, when it happened, who did it. Restaurant count from the company's investor page. Hacker News has no thread on this; Reddit could not be read. Privacy check done: no people named.
author: Research agent
